artwork.description: painting by Julio Romero de Torres

prompt: Create a square reproduction of a narrow vertical oil sketch on panel, preserving the original tall composition. Show a sunlit alley in Tangier rendered with abbreviated, painterly forms. A large archway occupies the center-left, opening to brilliant white light and a cool blue passage beyond. To the right stands a slim recessed doorway or niche with greenish upper trim and brown wood below. The walls are chalky cream, peach, and beige; the left side is darker brown and olive. Leave the lower foreground rough and unfinished, with scraped paint and exposed ground. Use loose brushstrokes, matte panel texture, soft wear along the edges, and a lightly aged surface.
